- `GET /status-lists/{slug}` — An issuer's status list, as its signer signed it (a Status List Token)
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers/{issuer_id}/status-lists` — The issuer's status lists, and whether each must be signed
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers/{issuer_id}/status-lists/sign` — Ask the issuer's signer's wallet to sign a status list as it is
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/applications/{application_id}/credential-status` — Suspend, reinstate or revoke an issued credential (the issuer's signer signs the status list that says so)

## Ask the issuer's signer's wallet to sign a status list as it is

`POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/issuers/{issuer_id}/status-lists/sign` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `issuer_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [SignListIn](/reference/api/schemas/#signlistin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `locale` *(optional)* | `en`, `es` | default `"en"` |
| `client` *(optional)* | `portal`, `cli` | default `"portal"` |
| `status_list_id` *(optional)* | string (uuid) or null |  |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [RequestOut](/reference/api/schemas/#requestout) |
| 403 | [`not_the_issuers_signer`](/reference/errors/#not_the_issuers_signer) |
| 404 | [`status_list_not_found`](/reference/errors/#status_list_not_found) |
| 409 | [`up_to_date`](/reference/errors/#up_to_date): signed by a key in force |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |

## Suspend, reinstate or revoke an issued credential (the issuer's signer signs the status list that says so)

`POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/applications/{application_id}/credential-status` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `application_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [CredentialStatusIn](/reference/api/schemas/#credentialstatusin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `locale` *(optional)* | `en`, `es` | default `"en"` |
| `client` *(optional)* | `portal`, `cli` | default `"portal"` |
| `status` | `valid`, `suspended`, `revoked` |  |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [RequestOut](/reference/api/schemas/#requestout) |
| 403 | [`not_the_issuers_signer`](/reference/errors/#not_the_issuers_signer) |
| 404 | [`application_not_found`](/reference/errors/#application_not_found) |
| 409 | [`not_issued`](/reference/errors/#not_issued); [`no_status_list`](/reference/errors/#no_status_list): issued before status lists; [`credential_revoked`](/reference/errors/#credential_revoked): revoking is final; [`status_unchanged`](/reference/errors/#status_unchanged) |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
